title: ContextCrate
description: Global and per-crate metrics for ContextCrate: API keys, ingestion pipeline, MCP usage, search, embeddings, reranking and LLM behaviour.

panels.title: Indexed documents
panels.description: Current document versions across all crates

panels.title: Dead-lettered work
panels.description: Work items that exhausted their retries

panels.title: Pipeline queue depth by stage
panels.description: Pending work items waiting for a worker

panels.title: Ingested documents
panels.description: new / updated / unchanged document versions found by the parser

panels.title: API key requests by key type
Answer verification results
panels.description: verified / unsupported / revised / blocked / unavailable / disabled

panels.title: Empty search ratio (1h)
panels.description: Share of search_crate calls that returned no passages — a sign of content gaps

panels.title: Most requested documents
panels.description: Top documents returned by search_crate / ask_crate or opened with fetch_document. Bounded to the top N per crate.

panels.title: Most used sources
panels.description: Sources (websites / repositories) whose content is returned most often

panels.title: API key requests by key
panels.description: Key names are bounded; keys beyond the limit are grouped as “other”

panels.title: Reranker effect: original top hit's new position
panels.description: 0 means the reranker agrees with retrieval; higher values mean it reorders heavily

panels.title: LLM requests
panels.description: purpose: grade (relevance grading), answer, verify, revise

panels.title: LLM time to first token (p50 / p95)
Grading: share of candidate chunks kept
panels.description: Low values mean retrieval returns many chunks the LLM grader rejects
